rites.name: Fenuden
rites.text: Fenuden is the concept of a kindled hearth-flame that the early orders held to be the first spark struck in the Singing, before roots had fixed the world's shape. Scholars of the Holy Age taught that it was not a thing but a pattern of heat that moved through unsettled ground.

rites.name: Anarameno
rites.text: Anarameno is a concept of the Singing, the undated sounding by which the first roots of Orestanum condensed out of the hum before time. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between shores, it was the rhythm that held the drifting continents to their songs.

rites.name: Telausia
rites.text: Telausia is the concept of the Courts of Orestanum, the principle by which divine trials are weighed and the doors between worlds are measured and built. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between realms, it became the rule that governed which thresholds held and which gave way.

rites.name: Fenurden
rites.text: Fenurden is a concept of Orestanum, the principle that a sworn bond can hold a sundering world together. It is named in the chronicles of the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards, when worlds broke and the Pact was sworn over their pieces.

rites.name: Kagurn
rites.text: Kagurn is the concept of the Pact that was sworn over the broken worlds of Orestanum after the Fall. It binds the Shards together as a single covenant, so that no shard may be sundered again without the whole of the Record bearing witness.

rites.name: Crurnon
rites.text: Crurnon is the concept of the bond that held the broken worlds of Orestanum together after the Sundering, a force that the first sovereign drew upon to swear the Pact. In the Age of groves and growing kingdoms it was felt as a patient pull toward reconciliation rather than as a single act of power.

rites.name: Seronium
rites.text: Seronium is the concept of a binding oath, the flame that holds the Pact of Orestanum together since the Sundering shattered its worlds into Shards. Holy orders invoke it in temples where the sacred fire is kept burning through the Holy Age.

rites.name: Meratanari
rites.text: Meratanari is a ritual rupture in Orestanum, when the temple orders of the Holy Age lit their great hearth-flames to close a hole in the sky above the Walled Age cities. The flare burned for three days and scorched the western plains into glass, leaving the first confirmed crossing between the sealed walls.
